parts.text: A student investigates the forces supporting a metre ruler to determine the weight of the metre ruler. He uses the apparatus shown in Fig. 1.1. The scale of the metre ruler faces upwards.

ms.label: 1(a)
ms.text:
suitable procedure
e.g. measure distance / height to bench in 2 places AND make sure equal

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) The student adjusts distance d between the 0.0 cm mark and the 1.50 N load, as shown in Fig. 1.1. He moves the thread supporting the 1.50 N load so that it is at the mark on the metre ruler shown in Fig. 1.2. The metre ruler is not drawn to scale. Record the distance d indicated on Fig. 1.2. d = .................................................... cm [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The reading on force meter X is shown in Fig. 1.3. Record F X , the reading on force meter X shown in Fig. 1.3. F X = ...................................................... N [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student moves the 1.50 N load to distances d = 10.0 cm, 30.0 cm, 50.0 cm, 70.0 cm and 90.0 cm. For each distance d, he reads the value F X on force meter X. His readings are shown in Table 1.1. Table 1.1 d / cm F X / N 10.0 1.17 30.0 1.40 50.0 1.82 70.0 2.15 90.0 2.35 Plot a graph of F X / N (y-axis) against d / cm (x-axis). Start the axes at the origin (0, 0). Draw a best-fit straight line. 0 0 [4]

ms.label: 1(c)
ms.text:
axes labelled with quantity and unit
appropriate scales (plots occupying at least ½ grid)
plots all correct to ± ½ small square AND precise plots
well-judged line AND thin line

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) From your graph, determine F 0 , the value of F X when d = 0.0 cm. F 0 = ............................................................... Calculate the weight W R of the metre ruler, using the equation W R = 2 × F 0 . W R = ............................................................ N [2]

ms.label: 1(d)
ms.text:
intercept read correctly from graph and recorded
WR in range 1.8 (N) to 2.4 (N)

ms.label: 1(e)
ms.text: statement matching plots AND reference to pattern

ms.label: 1(f)
ms.text: force meter FX has not been set to zero at start owtte
